# Birko.Data.StoreFactory.Tests

## Overview

xUnit + FluentAssertions tests for TASK-990's backend-neutral store factory: `IStoreFactory`, `StoreProviders`,
`StoreFactory.Create` (by name + connection string, and by settings object) in Birko.Data.Stores, the
`GetAsyncRepository` extension in Birko.Data.Repositories, and each backend's registration (`AddInMemory`, `AddJson`,
`AddXml`, `AddSqLite`, `AddMongoDB`, `AddElasticSearch`, `AddRavenDB`, `AddCosmosDB`).

## Project Location

`tests/Birko.Data.StoreFactory.Tests/`

## Scope

- `StoreFactoryTests`, one class. `ExerciseAsync` is the shared store suite (schema if offered, CRUD, count, bulk
  create, filtered update, a repository, an aggregate if offered, delete), run through the neutral interface on every
  backend.
- **Offline:** InMemory, JSON, XML (a temp folder, each type in its own file, reopened by a second factory) and SQLite;
  backend choice (unregistered name, duplicate registration, case, settings by type, an ambiguous base `Settings`, a
  subclass of a backend's settings); each networked backend's connection-string parsing and refusals (nothing connects
  until a store is used); a TASK-988 `ISqlStoreFactory` is also an `IStoreFactory`.
- **Live**, skipped without the variable and failed under `BIRKO_REQUIRE_LIVE`: `BIRKO_MONGO_HOST` (+`_PORT`),
  `BIRKO_ES_URL`, `BIRKO_RAVEN_URL`, `BIRKO_COSMOS_CONNECTION` (+`_MODE`). Each run uses its own database / index prefix.
  Elasticsearch is near-real-time, so its run refreshes `{prefix}_*` after each write (the store contract's `Settle`).

## Conventions

- The namespace is `Birko.Data.StoreFactory.Tests` **on purpose**: inside `Birko.Data.*` it hides the
  `Birko.Data.Stores.StoreFactory` class from any framework code that writes the bare name, so a backend file that does
  stops compiling here. Write `Birko.Data.Stores.StoreFactory` in full, in tests and in the framework.
- Run with `dotnet test --nologo` from this folder.
